cases.iut_type: BLE product using the same module and host stack
cases.customer_question: Can future derivative models using the same module and host stack be added after this registration?
question_variants: How do we add variants after qualification?
Can models with the same Bluetooth module be added for free?
Can products using the same module and host stack be added to the existing Product List?
Do derivative models need a new qualification?
How should expansion models be registered?
cases.actual_issue: Handling later product variants that use the same Bluetooth module and host stack as the already registered product.
cases.plain_english_explanation: After the main registration was complete, the consultant explained that future models using the same module and host stack could be added through the submitted-products management page. The thread says this can be done by a simple web operation and is free for those same-module/same-host-stack expansion models. The key condition is that the future models use the same Bluetooth implementation basis.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant stated that future expansion models equipped with the same module and host stack as the current registration can be added to the current Product List from the Manage Submitted Products list created in My Page. The consultant described this as a simple web operation and provided an additional-product registration procedure document.
cases.decision_logic: The eligibility depends on sameness of the Bluetooth implementation: the later model must use the same module and host stack as the registered product. When that condition is met, the later model can be added to the existing Product List rather than treated as a separate new qualification case in this thread.
cases.final_recommendation: For derivative models using the same module and host stack, add them to the existing Product List through Manage Submitted Products using the provided additional-product registration procedure.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Creating a new qualification unnecessarily could add avoidable work and cost. Adding a model that does not actually use the same Bluetooth implementation could make the listing inaccurate.
